message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts: The defendant signed a lease with the car owner, then fraudulently pretended to be the owner, signed a lease with a victim, collected rent and deposit, and refused to return. This is fraud (诈骗罪) under Chinese Criminal Law, with large amount. Also possibly "非法占有" and "诈骗" is the main. Could also be "合同诈骗罪" (contract fraud) which is a specific type of fraud under article 224 of Criminal Law. The description: "以非法占有为目的，在签订、履行合同过程中，采取虚构事实、隐瞒真相的手段，骗取他人财物" matches "合同诈骗罪". So the crime is "合同诈骗罪". The format: single crime: [罪名]合同诈骗罪<eoa>. The JSON format: {"final_answer": "[罪名]合同诈骗罪<eoa>"}
